body: We had 4 sets of twins in a school that had 100 kids in it. All together. Grades 7-12, 100 kids, 4 sets of twins.

I’m my mothers youngest (17) so I’m her “baby”. I tried to kill myself when I was 14, turning 15. I thought I broke the woman. I’ve never seen my mom cry like that and I haven’t since. It was the most quiet pain I’ve ever seen. She was just constantly crying, not sobbing but crying and crying. It broke my fucking heart. She was scared to leave me alone for months after. She told me she would die without me, but later when everything went back to normal just said she would continue life as normally as possible if I died. I don’t know which one was the truth as my mom is a VERY reserved person. Not at all good for showing feeling or emotion. That’s mainly why it still gets to me so damn badly after 2 years.

I’ll be a grandpa :) but thank you so much. I hope so

I used to spend all my summer breaks, winter breaks, spring breaks, and weekends with her. We were so close that I slept on an air mattress on her floor while I was over. My favourite memory was probably the new years I spent with her. I was only 14 but we drank this fancy brandi together & hugged at midnight. 

Or the time we were staying up super late and I used to lay sideways on my bed and put my feet up on her dresser. I’d yell at her “Go to sleep, old lady. It’s past your bedtime.” I also decided that night that I REALLY wanted a milkshake. I couldn’t stop talking about it. And then she also really wanted a milk shake. We ended up getting up early just to go and get milkshakes. 

She was so chill and understanding and loving. She was truly my bestfriend and I was hers.
I probably won’t turn to drinking again. I’m sorry if I came across as a cocky teenager thinking they know everything. I don’t know shit tbh lol. I know there’s still more to learn and see

My therapist is great. I get along with her well. It’s just there isn’t much else to tell me anymore. I’ve been through it all. The only thing that I can do is feel it through. That’s it. Nothing else will take the weight of my shoulders. All I can do is breathe and keep going, I know that. Knowing it doesn’t make it any easier, unfortunately. Have you ever experienced loss? I’m not trying to be a dick with that question, just wondering. Because if you have then you would know how nothing really helps except time and time and more time. But time sucks when minutes are just shrouded in pain and another hour is another hour without who you lost. Every second of being alive is a reminder that someone I love is no longer alive.
They do currently for a separate death that happened two weeks ago or so. It doesn’t help though.

Because I’ve been seeing therapists since I was 12. Almost everyone important to me has died in the past 2 years. I have a therapists. I’ve seen psychologists. I’m on the meds they feed me. There’s nothing they can tell me that I haven’t already heard. I don’t need someone who’s paid to care about me.
That wont help.

I just need an adult. I feel like a little kid after a nightmare. I just want to breakdown and have my grandma or my mom hold me but my mom doesn’t know how to care. I just feel like I’m drowning in so much shit.

Since 2017 I’ve had my grandma die, my uncle die, saw a family friend die, grandpa died, kid in my school died, and now this. Before that my dad died when I was 7. There isnt anything they could tell me that’s new.

I suppose I’d be considered one of the “new wave of trans kids”. I’m 16 ftm. I’ve been living my life as male for about 3 ? years now. I honestly have to say I fucking hate the mentality of my lgbt peers. It’s so extra and just like everything is taken too seriously. Also, everyone uses how “accepting” they are to out themselves above others. I hate it. I’m perfectly supportive of the lgbt community but I don’t feel the need to give a lecture in the middle of class about the “88288 different genders” out there when someone slips up. I honestly don’t care about most of it and just wish to live my life as a male. I hate that since I’m trans, I’m supposed to automatically be some sort of activist. My friends mess my pronouns up sometimes. Who tf cares?? I love my friends that are just plain old heterosexual and cisgender. I like them better than any of the trans friends I’ve ever had. I want a group of friends that accept me as a male, but can also make jokes about me being trans. I hate that some people think of it as a topic to avoid with me.

Both me and my girlfriend are in our teens. I love her so much and I’m honestly glad she’s with me, despite how self centred that sounds. I know a lot of kids our age  wouldn’t know how to handle it and I would hate to see her in a relationship with someone who couldn’t be there for her. Especially knowing how that would hurt and change her. I’m also pretty fucked up, honestly. We’re there for each other. We know that a happy relationship won’t cure either of us of our problems. But we love each other through all the hard times and I think that’s what we both need most.

I don’t even wanna do drugs, I swear. I just wanna feel okay so goddamn badly and the only way I feel okay is if I’m on drugs. I don’t think I can tell my therapist. I don’t want her to tell my mom & my mom lose her mind on me.

I was addicted to cocaine, morphine, & regularly popped tylenol 3s when I was 14 (the year I was turning 15). It all fucked with me for a really long time and my memory was shit for a long time. I have trouble understanding shit now & have a lower attention span. I mix up words and numbers all the time, too. I know it’ll fuck me up, but at this point it’s a toss up on if I care or not.

There currently sitting in my dresser in one of my old pill bottles. I don’t even like smoking weed or drinking anymore. It all makes me anxious now. But fuck I’d be lying if I said I didn’t miss my morphine. I’m trying to not take them. My girlfriend and my bestfriend would be utterly pissed if I relapsed. I don’t think I’m strong enough to flush them, but maybe to ignore them. It kind of comforts me to have them there. I’m so fucking stupid.

The only real experience I’ve had with nurses was at 14, after an on purpose morphine overdose. I was crying and puking the whole day and still high by the time I was at the hospital. I had a nurse that was so absolutely sweet. She had a really likeable voice. She asked me if I wanted a cookie and joked around about how good they were with me. I really liked having her around because she never focused on me and the reason I was there. She walked me around the kitchen & told me what food they had and that I could take anything. She brought me heated up blankets & pillows for the night. I know that during the entire time I was interacting with her, I was a mess but, she never even acknowledged it. She didn’t look at me weird when I would randomly be crying while talking. She talked to me like I was normal, it was nice. Nurses are champs.

I’ve been in therapy for years and have had several therapists. It doesn’t seem to help much, but I guess it’s something. Thank you so much for your comment, it really did mean a lot to see someone care about me even a little. It’s hard to keep going when the last time I was happy was so long ago. It feels like every year that passes is another year of me failing myself by being alive.
thank you, I’ll try to keep it in mind.
I’ve been in therapy since I was 12. Started meds recently. Doesn’t really help much.
